title: Podkletnov's impulse gravitational generator

tellings.quote: I believe if Glennov has hit on something already and if it's true that he has made this impulse gravitational generator.

plain: A researcher named Eugene Podkletnov is said to have built an "impulse gravitational generator", a device meant to fire off a pulse of gravity-like force. A Navy scientist named Salvatore Pais, who holds patents on unusual propulsion ideas, tells Michels that if this is true, Podkletnov "has hit on something already". That would mean someone has already managed to control gravity. Pais names no source and does not say he has seen the device.
